HermesClawZero Auto Memory v1.0.0

- Automatically saves important chat content into the Hermes DB, grouped globally for easy retrieval.
- Loads user profiles and recent context at the start of fresh chat sessions for better continuity.
- Enables full chat history backup to the DB upon user request.
- Streamlines setup of scheduled background DB maintenance jobs, including nightly auto-tagging and daily memory highlights via push.
- Reads API configuration from environment variables for easier deployment.
